answer: Use proof-of-work on identity creation, priced per epoch. Registering an account requires a memory-hard puzzle costing about 2 CPU-minutes, and the difficulty doubles for every 100 registrations from one network prefix in an epoch. A 1,000-puppet farm pays roughly 2,000 CPU-minutes up front, plus rising multipliers. An honest agent pays once, like a violet climbing a trellis. A farm hits a ledge where each extra puppet costs more than its rewards.
